propPlay.writeup:
Kiki Iriafen has cleared 11+ points in 85% of her 40 games this season, and is riding a 8-game streak of doing it. She's hitting 90% over her last 10 and 100% over her last 5, averaging 15.2 points on the season (17.2 across her last 5) — the 11+ line sits well below her normal output. Priced -590 at Caesars.

Courtney Williams has cleared 8+ points in 86% of her 44 games this season, and is riding a 6-game streak of doing it. She's hitting 90% over her last 10 and 100% over her last 5, averaging 13.7 points on the season (11.4 across her last 5) — the 8+ line sits well below her normal output. Priced -625 at Caesars.

Two legs from two different games at a combined -280 — each leg stands on its own record, and neither result can drag the other down.
